headline: Record Volumes, Margins Await Huron

highlights: Key Points  Jyoti CNC Automation’s (JCAL) consolidated revenue grew 19% YoY to Rs6.02bn, but EBITDA rose only 5% to Rs1,313mn with margin down ~270bps YoY to 21.8%, and PAT fell 15% to Rs726mn.

Against our estimates, revenue was 12% ahead on record volumes, EBITDA was in line (-1%) and PAT was 3% lower, as a 30% tax rate (26% estimated) and higher depreciation outweighed lower interest.  Operational performance: Machine volumes rose 45% YoY to a record 1,911 units (we estimated 1,500), but entry-level machines were 94% of the mix, cutting realisation to ~Rs3.0mn.
The standalone business grew 31% YoY at a 27.9% EBITDA margin, while Huron added only ~Rs150mn as ~Rs600mn awaits end-user certificates.
valuation: We maintain our 40x multiple and roll forward our valuation to 2QFY29E based on blended FY28E/FY29E EPS of Rs30.7, arriving at a revised TP of Rs1,226 (earlier Rs1,154) vs CMP of Rs976, implying 27% upside.
Operating cash flow was ~47% of EBITDA in H1, with a ~50% target for the year.

CMP: Rs967 | Target Price (TP): Rs1,226 | Upside: 27% November 4, 2026 Institutional Equities Jyoti CNC Automation Ltd 2 Order book and healthy execution visibility: The order book stands at Rs50.82bn after Rs8.09bn of intake and Rs5.75bn of execution in Q2, a book-to-bill of ~1.4x.
